article_title: Towards Generalizable Representations of Mathematical Strategies
citation: Siddhartha Pradhan, Ethan Prihar, and Erin Ottmar. (2026). Towards Generalizable Representations of Mathematical Solution Strategies. arXiv. https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08693
title: From Here To There! (FH2T) gamified algebra platform
description: FH2T is a gamified mathematics learning environment in which "algebraic equations are represented as interactive virtual objects that students manipulate through dynamic actions such as tapping and dragging." It contains 252 problems organized into 14 worlds ordered by increasing difficulty, and students transform a start state into a mathematically equivalent goal state through any sequence of valid transitions. The platform grants students autonomy to explore different strategies, and its logs supply the algebraic states, transitions, and solution pathways analyzed in this study.
requirements: Students must complete all preceding problems before advancing to the next world; solving a problem rewards students based on the efficiency of their solution strategy.
constraints: The study's analysis relied on a subset of data from the RCT and focused on the FH2T platform.
examples: Example Problem 7 transforms the start state 11 + 55 + y + 89 + 45 into the goal state 100 + y + 100 via valid algebraic transitions.
